_note: Every image on the site is looked up here by id. Photos: put the original in D:\SMSDC\SMSDC-Images, add it to scripts/process-clinic-photos.mjs, run `npm run photos -- "D:\SMSDC\SMSDC-Images"` (resizes + strips EXIF/GPS into /public/images/gallery), then add an entry here. caption/category/placement are optional: category = clinic | treatments | education; placement = gallery, home, about, og. Never use photos of people as if they were our doctors; patients only with written consent.
